title: EmDash quickstart site: /app is www-data's, so rebuild, pnpm install/add and a restart work as the site user
steps: S1: In packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation run node --test on test/emdash-tools-layer-install.test.mjs, test/emdash-post-up.test.mjs and test/mint-agent-token.test.mjs.
S2: Read the results of the tools-layer tests (install-emdash-receiver.mjs against a stubbed root filesystem).
S3: Read the results of the mint-helper and owner-guard tests (platform/emdash.sh, mint-agent-token.sh).
expect: S2: a quickstart archive is unpacked without its owners, built, then everything under /app is handed back to the site user
S2: pnpm-workspace.yaml and node_modules/.modules.yaml name the same store inside /app, idempotently; another EmDash version still gets the store pin and the owners
S2: the site user gets a home and the project's pnpm is fetched as that user in /app; a failed fetch only warns
S2: a non-quickstart image gets no store rewrite, no chown, no home and no Corepack run; a bad archive checksum fails the layer
S3: /app/tracy-mint.cjs is removed after a clean mint and after a failed one (the failure still fails)
S3: foreign owners under /app are warned about (digest excluded) without failing the site; a clean /app prints nothing
evidence: Owner investigation 24/10/2026 on dev (site emdashown1024): 1,589 uid-501 + 832 root files under /app from the tools layer; astro build EACCES; pnpm add ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE; a failed reinstall emptied node_modules.
fence: web/install-emdash-receiver.mjs hands /app back to www-data and pins the pnpm store; platform/emdash.sh removes tracy-mint.cjs and warns on foreign owners.

tests: quickstart, compatible EmDash: unpacked without the archive owners
quickstart: node_modules and pnpm-workspace.yaml name the same store
quickstart on another EmDash version: store pinned and owners handed back
not a quickstart (no site user owns /app): no store rewrite, no chown
an archive that does not match its checksum fails the layer
quickstart: the site user gets a home and the pinned pnpm
quickstart: a failed pnpm fetch is a warning
not a quickstart: no home is created and Corepack is not run
mint helper: removed from /app after a clean mint
mint helper: removed from /app after a failed mint
owner guard: foreign files under /app are reported
owner guard: a clean /app prints no warning
